paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of novel tungsten heavy alloys prepared using FeNiCoCrCu HEA as binder

evidence.quote: novel tungsten heavy alloys (WHAs) have been developed using FeNiCoCrCu high entropy alloy (HEA) as binder through conventional sintering process.
